body: Mhh. You changed the meaning now, right? It used to be just the `symbol` and now it is `symbol` and `style`. How about simplifying the naming to `full`, `charging`, `discharging`, `unknown` and `empty`? That's a breaking change for users but this is breaking anyway, right?

Renaming do make sense, but it will not break previous code.

This is equivalent to calling `config_value_segment_config` if you are familiar with #378.

Mhh. I might be understanding it wrongly but I would assume that when I had earlier in my configuration
```
[battery]
full_symbol = "🔋"
```
This won't be recognized now anymore but has to be changed to
```
[battery.full_symbol]
    value = "🔋"
```
or is `value` a magic default `key`?

No, both

```toml
[battery]
full_symbol = "B "
```

and

```toml
[battery]
full_symbol = { value = "B " }
```

will work as described [here](https://github.com/heyrict/starship/blob/26db0cef52ebc7fdcac0ce59a75448d854a58ce0/docs/config/README.md#styling) (currently undocumented due to discussion in #378)

If you want reference to code, [here it is](https://github.com/heyrict/starship/blob/master/starship/src/config.rs#L181-L220).
